docs.text: TwinC Prediction and functional interpretation of inter-chromosomal genome architecture from DNA sequence with TwinC TwinC is a Python package for training, inference, and interpretation of trans-3D genome folding in humans. TwinC uses a Convolutional Neural Network model that predicts contact between two trans genomic loci from nucleotide sequences. The model takes two 100 kbp nucleotide sequences as input and treats the task of predicting trans contacts as a classification task. To reproduce analyses performed in Jha et al. (2024) , please check out TwinC 2024 manuscript repository .

docs.text: Full dataset This dataset can be used to reproduce results in the TwinC manuscript. Please download this data in the same folder as the TwinC paper repository . We have submitted our training datasets to zenodo.org/records/15802811 . The datasets are divided into three parts: Data The sequence data can be downloaded using: cd twinc-paper/ wget https://zenodo.org/records/15802811/files/TwinC_data_resources_V1.tar.gz After downloading, you can uncompress the file, and it will populate the data folder. tar -xvzf TwinC_data_resources_V1.tar.gz Labels Labels for training, as well as intermediate results for reproducing the figures, can be downloaded using: cd twinc-paper/ wget https://zenodo.org/records/15802811/files/TwinC_label_resources_V1.tar.gz After downloading, you can uncompress the file, and it will populate the results folder. tar -xvzf TwinC_label_resources_V1.tar.gz Models You can download the pretrained models using: cd twinc-paper/ wget https://zenodo.org/records/15802811/files/TwinC_models_V1.tar.gz After downloading, you can uncompress the file, and it will populate the models folder. tar -xvzf TwinC_models_V1.tar.gz

docs.text: Downloads Example dataset We are providing an example dataset to test your TwinC installation and to prepare data, label and configuration files for training TwinC in a new tissue or cell line. cd twinc/ wget https://zenodo.org/records/15802811/files/TwinC_example_V1.tar.gz After downloading, you can uncompress the file, and it will populate the data folder. tar -xvzf TwinC_example_V1.tar.gz This dataset contains: 1. hg38.no_Y_MT.fa: Fasta file for the human genome containing chromosomes 1-22 and X. hg38.no_Y_MT.fa.fai: Index for the fasta file. hg38.no_Y_MT.memmap: One-hot-encoded memory map for the human genome. A -> [1, 0, 0, 0] C -> [0, 1, 0, 0] G -> [0, 0, 1, 0] T -> [0, 0, 0, 1] train_labels.txt: Training labels. A text file containing genomic coordinates from chromosomes A and B, a contact label (0 -> no contact, 1 -> contact) and KR-normalized contact frequency. The columns in the files are as follows: ``` chrA_Name: Name of the first chromosome. chrA_Start: Start coordinate in chrA. chrA_End: End coordinate in chrA. chrB_Name: Name of the second chromosome. chrB_Start: Start coordinate in chrB. chrB_End: End coordinate in chrB. Contact_Label: Whether the two loci are in contact (0->No, 1->Yes). Contact_Frequency: KR-Normalized contact frequency. ``` val_labels.txt: Validation labels. test_labels.txt: Test labels.
